supersedes.rationale: remove the model-facing anyOf(answer object, null) union while preserving the same semantic candidate result contract

answer.name: submit_candidate_answer
answer.description: Submit an answer result. Use this tool only when the final status is answer. The value must match the case-visible answer_value_schema.

non_answer.name: submit_candidate_non_answer
non_answer.description: Submit a non-answer result. Use this tool only for abstain, escalate, or reject_action. This tool deliberately has no value field.

semantic_reconstruction.answer: set status=answer and use the answer tool arguments as the remaining candidate fields
semantic_reconstruction.non_answer: set value=null and use the non-answer tool arguments as the remaining candidate fields

deterministic_validation: after tool argument parsing, reconstruct the unchanged candidate_output_contract v3 object and validate it locally
